# Retained Bondtech INDX regression input

These six files are byte-for-byte copies of the M92 accepted Bondtech sample,
retained outside runtime catalog discovery for its dedicated provenance, grouped
source, independent coupling geometry and edit/history regressions. They are test
fixtures, not another public sample or part of the generated frontend catalog.

When the reviewed catalog includes this key, the dedicated tests consume its live
catalog project. If the reviewed catalog explicitly retires it, those same tests
consume this authenticated original project through the ordinary public decoder;
missing keys without explicit retirement remain failures. The retired registry
lookup/menu/Recent boundary is tested separately against the catalog contract.

The authored seeds and mathematical/history assertions are unchanged. No fixture
is automatically regenerated from later catalog edits. Original file SHA-256:
